note: Blocked-cycle count outside a bounded wait: in the count's next value for an instruction other than WAITPIN/WAITEVENT (the default of the opcode chain), during an XFER, or in a PULL/PUSH stall, the mutation forces a bit to 0, or flips a bit only while another bit of the count is 1; there the count is 0 (every completion and START clear it, and only a bounded wait increments it). 86 toggles bit 5 on every cycle of a PUSH stall (or on a strict overflow) while bit 0 is 0; the PUSH's completion clears the count again (and START after a STOP or the fault), before any bounded wait reads it.
